title: CORE Processed Reference Cache v1
description: Schema for a processed reference cache entry that stores a summary keyed by window fingerprint and may carry source provenance fingerprints.

window_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the bounded read window this cache is keyed on.

summary_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the processed summary content.

classification_candidate_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the classification candidate that validated this cache entry.

source_refs.description: Optional source references used to derive the processed cache entry.

source_fingerprints.description: Optional provenance fingerprints aligned with source_refs.

cache_status.description: Whether the cache is still valid given the current window fingerprint.
